name: shoppable-list
title: Shoppable list
description: A recipe or project as a shopping list: amounts that scale with servings, substitutes for sold-out lines, and one button that adds the checked products to the cart.
docs: Each item is a product (id, name, price of one pack, optional packSize) with the amount the recipe needs for servings people. With servings the list gets a servings field and every amount scales, and so does the number of packs: 600 g needs two 500 g packs. A line with no amount (note: "to taste") is bought once. defaultChecked: false starts a line unchecked, for things the reader probably owns. A sold-out line (inStock: false) cannot be checked and offers its substitute; swapping checks it and onAddAll then carries the substitute's id. onAddAll receives only the checked lines, each with the product id, the packs, the price of one pack and the total; return a promise and the button shows it is working. list.ts holds the arithmetic and runs on the server too.
